channel.title: HSJ - Latest news
channel.description: Custom RSS feed for HSJ latest news

item.title: Second trust’s delay telling Southport victims of data breaches was ‘appalling’
item.description: An ambulance trust waited nearly two months before informing victims of the 2024 Southport attack that their patient records may have been accessed inappropriately by staff, HSJ has discovered.

item.title: Many maternity units have ‘structural difficulties’, PM admits
item.description: The prime minister has admitted “structural difficulties” similar to those faced by a rural maternity unit recently forced to close over staff shortages are widespread across the NHS.

item.title: Recognise negative impact mutual aid can have on performance, pleads trust CEO
item.description: The chief executive of a trust that has fallen 34 places in NHS England’s provider performance league table has complained that the ranking fails to take into account its efforts to help neighbours.

item.title: Government U-turns on ICB board change
item.description: The government has U-turned on Health Bill proposals to remove mandated council representation from integrated care boards.

item.title: Leading joint health and care deal falls foul of financial pressures
item.description: NHS financial pressures and reforms have brought about the end of one of the largest local joint health and social care funding arrangements.

item.title: How serial fraudster secured nine senior managerial roles
item.description: A fraudster secured 13 management and administrative jobs over 10 years, despite extensive pre- and post-recruitment checks by trusts, commissioners, national bodies, and recruitment agencies, HSJ has discovered.

item.title: Trust fails in bid to overturn CQC warning notice
item.description: One of the NHS’s most troubled trusts made an unsuccessful attempt to prevent the Care Quality Commission issuing it with a warning notice.

item.title: ICB bids to save its Healthwatch branch from abolition
item.description: An integrated care board is planning to pay £1.6m to retain its local Healthwatch for the next four years.

item.title: ICB with 30-fold increase in neurodiversity spend now paying 42 private providers
item.description: An integrated care board which has seen the amount it spends on autism and ADHD care increase 30-fold in three years is set to bust its budget again.

item.title: Exclusive: Trust admits to harming 200 patients
item.description: Almost 200 patients suffered harm after a major teaching trust failed to manage its neurological waiting lists effectively, HSJ has discovered.

item.title: Revealed: The eight trusts with ‘worse than expected’ inpatient care
item.description: Eight trusts performed “worse than expected”, the Care Quality Commission’s annual survey of inpatient experience at acute and specialist trusts has revealed.

item.title: PM should remember ‘the North isn’t just Manchester’, says trust CEO
item.description: Andy Burnham should recognise that areas in the North of England other than Greater Manchester require more investment, the chief executive of a Tyneside trust has told HSJ.

item.title: ICBs must retain some responsibility for trust performance, says CEO
item.description: Integrated care boards must continue to be involved in improving the performance of provider trusts, an ICB chief executive has claimed.

item.title: Trust’s ‘off balance sheet’ funding plan rejected by NHSE
item.description: A trust’s proposed use of an off-balance-sheet funding model to finance the expansion of a new building project has been rejected by NHS England, forcing the cancellation of a £94m managed services contract.

item.title: End of life care waits help push delayed discharges to record levels
item.description: Hospital discharge delays hit their highest level on record in July.

item.title: Senior managers’ pay rise on hold as ministers review rules for struggling trusts
item.description: Directors and other “very senior managers” at trusts and integrated care boards are still waiting for their agreed pay rise for 2026-27, despite the financial year being nearly half over.

item.title: Governor claims he was intimidated ‘for reposting HSJ articles’
item.description: A governor has accused the leadership of a major hospital trust of seeking to “intimidate” him by launching a probe into his social media posts.

item.title: Trusts face £900m bill to end zero-hours contracts, employers warn
item.description: Government attempts to crack down on “exploitative” zero-hours contracts could adversely affect bank staff and cost the NHS £900m a year, the body representing NHS workforce leaders has claimed.

item.title: Pioneer CEO: ‘IHOs won’t fix all ills’
item.description: The CEO of a leading trust that is set to begin a “phased” launch of an integrated health organisation has warned the model should not be expected to “fix the ills of everything”.

item.title: In-house EPRs can avoid ‘phenomenal’ costs, says top CEO
item.description: A leading hospital chief executive has championed in-house NHS technology that costs “a fraction” of major commercial systems – and said she does not use the federated data platform.
